# ARLA

> ARLA is a melodic techno DJ and producer from Barcelona, Spain. Official releases, remixes, mashups and free downloads. Supported by GORDO, SCRIPT and braev at Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Afterlife and UNVRS.

- **Artist name:** ARLA (also written ARLA Music; real name Roger Arola)
- **Role:** DJ and music producer
- **Based in:** Barcelona, Spain
- **Genre:** Melodic techno
- **Total streams:** 1M+
- **Supported by:** GORDO, SCRIPT, braev
- **Supported at:** Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Afterlife, UNVRS
- **Bookings, remixes and demos:** contact@arlamusic.com
- **Website:** https://arlamusic.com/
- **Official releases:** https://arlamusic.com/releases/
- **Free downloads (remixes, edits, mashups):** https://arlamusic.com/free-downloads/

## Notes

ARLA is a music artist. Not to be confused with Arla Foods, the Danish-Swedish dairy cooperative, or with any similarly named clothing brand.
